entry.title: Page size
entry.summary: The number of children each listing page shows, set per hub, per section or for the site.
entry.content:
The page size is how many children each listing page shows. The most specific setting wins:

  1. the hub’s own hub_page_size frontmatter, as on this example’s hub;
  2. hub.pageSize on the section in docs/_meta/sections.yaml, or in the charter’s sections.entries;
  3. hub.pageSize in defineDocKittyIntegrations;
  4. the default, 50.

A page size is a positive whole number. Any other value stops the build with a message that names the setting.
